newsitem.title: UK: Euro jet fuel gains on stronger futures, but slow.
newsitem.headline: Euro jet fuel gains on stronger futures, but slow.

text.p: European jet fuel was kicked higher on Friday by sharply stronger gas oil futures, even though premiums were broadly unchanged.
May IPE gas oil was trading $3.25 a tonne higher at $164.25 on the back of concern over a growing European spat with Iran and colder weather in the U.S.

Barge premiums were unchanged at May IPE gas oil +$18 fob ARA, with one 2,000 tonne parcel sold at this level. Cargoes in NWE were assessed around May IPE gas oil +$21-22 cif NWE, but no trade was heard.
"Its pretty quiet, there is not much buying," said one trader, who added that there was easily enough supply to meet the moderate demand.
The Mediterranean was looking more balanced with barrels turning over at high fob quotes +$7-8 although one Greek cargo was starting to look a touch distressed.
